240-5470-8201-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

955-1395-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2316-4871-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4871-7824.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1115-3259-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness, is a creature and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it

5147-7124-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
5147-7124-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5147-7124-7759.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

328-413-3260-4078.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-413-3260-4078.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
328-413-3260-4078.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.

3617-5913-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-1671-2638-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-2638-4231-6441.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-5231-7199.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5795-6632-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Water Crystal.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3062-3899-4324-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4352-5231-6972--112.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
4352-5231-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

4593-4659-6291-6752.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter the battlefield, Haliya triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4593-4659-6291-6752.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter.

3525-4549-6702.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Kilo, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

4927-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
4927-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3490-4659-5070.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-5070.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

5414-5478-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
5414-5478-5720-5721.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1365-4853-5231-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-4853-5231-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher, adding {R}.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

2092-3488-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2092-3488-4131.description:
Activate Katsumasa by paying {2}{U}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

575-1184-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kin-Tree Warden, adding {C}{C}.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

413-3783-4300.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
413-3783-4300.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land you control to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
When the Illusion enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion token.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

517-1185-2383.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
You had an Angel and/or a Berserker enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
517-1185-2383.description:
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Peace of Mind by paying {W} and discarding Cleaving Reaper, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Cleaving Reaper by paying three life, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1640-2474-3011.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
1640-2474-3011.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to 1.5 times their life total, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah's Shield.

3957-5062.notablePrerequisites:
Porcuparrot mutated on Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
3957-5062.description:
Give Famished Paladin lifelink.
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2308-3330.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-3330.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

260-1294-2167-4423-4426.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands and one basic Forest.
260-1294-2167-4423-4426.description:
Activate a Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Summer Bloom by paying {1}{G}, allowing you to play three more lands this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or from your graveyard.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, putting Summer Bloom on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Waterlogged Grove by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Summer Bloom from the top of your library.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and a Forest, adding {G}{U}.
Play the Forest and Waterlogged Grove from your graveyard.
Repeat.

721-2724-4933.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Blood Clock triggers, allowing you to return Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Repeat each turn.
